title: Traffic Management and Collision Investigator (TMCI) (GySgt to Cpl) NMOS (5811), DC I&L
raw_text:
4. MOS 5813, Traffic Management and Collision Investigator (TMCI) (GySgt to
Cpl) NMOS (5811), DC I&L

    a. Summary. A Traffic Management and Collision Investigator (TMCI) is a
military policeman who is additionally trained in the enforcement of traffic
laws, regulations and orders. Furthermore, the Traffic Management and
Collision Investigator (TMCI) investigates and reports traffic collisions,
assists in accident prevention and vehicle safety programs, conducts traffic
control studies to determine present and future needs concerning traffic
control, associated traffic programs or special events aboard and
installation, conducts comprehensive roadside safety checkpoints, maintains
PMO/MCPD intoxilyzer, RADAR and LIDAR equipment.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Must have obtained the grade of corporal or higher.

            (2) Must currently hold and maintain all prerequisites of PMOS 5811.

    c. Requirements. Complete the Traffic Management and Collision
Investigation Course (F06CAH1), 343 Training Squadron, Lackland, AFB.


                                          3-331                        Enclosure (1)
 3136                                                                  NAVMC 1200.1L



    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (ac), Military Police, Investigations, and Corrections Training and
Readiness Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Police and Sheriff's Patrol Officers 33-3051.

       f.   Related Military Skill.    None.
